protocol: continued high-resolution patch-head training; deployed SciPy L-BFGS-B forward with KKT implicit differentiation of the same bounded LiDAR-camera objective; final pose MPE/MOE loss plus weak normalized pixel supervision
training_split: manifest split=train only; validation frames and GT are never loaded by fine-tuning
selection: fixed final epoch; no validation-based stopping or checkpoint selection

loss.pose: final deployed-backend translation norm / training mean baseline MPE plus SO(3) geodesic degrees / training mean baseline MOE
loss.pixel: visible-point smooth L1 endpoint loss / training mean baseline pixel endpoint error

deployed_backend.objective: quadratic precision-weighted visual reprojection plus LiDAR information-matrix prior and existing negative-depth penalty
deployed_backend.note: The frozen deployed objective has no robust visual loss term; no new robust term was added.
deployed_backend.implicit_gradient: KKT active-set derivative over free dimensions; active bound dimensions receive zero local derivative

validation.note: The 32-frame set is a repeatedly used development set from the same sequence, not an independent test sequence.
